task_progress._note: Section title 'Task progress' (campaign_log id 'task_progress', type 'investigator_count'). Per-investigator numeric counter. In scenario 03_an_offer_you_cant_refuse each investigator is assigned exactly one task and its progress is initialized to 0, then incremented as the campaign proceeds. No single campaign-wide max exists in the reference data: each task's completion threshold lives on its individual task card, not in campaign.json, so 'max' is intentionally left unset. The 8 possible tasks (per the 'obligations' list achievement and 'picked_*' hidden log entries) are: no_place_like_home, walk_in_faith, toe_the_line, good_money, prove_your_worth, do_no_harm, dreams_of_destruction, plumb_the_depths.
